나 혼자만 레벨업 [Na Honjaman Level Up] #13

Solo Leveling, Vol. 13

Dubu (Artist), Chugong (Original Author), h-goon (Adapter)

4.52
3,810 ratings280 reviews
Rate this book
Outnumbered a hundred to one, Jinwoo and his shadow army ready themselves for the fight that will determine the fate of the whole world. As hunters worldwide gather to make mankind's last stand, Jinwoo focuses on the gate closest to home and those he loves. A superior strategy is his only hope in the face of such overwhelming odds, but as the first wave emerges, it's clear his foes are already a step ahead of the new Shadow Monarch...Has Jinwoo leveled up enough to defend humanity from certain destruction?!

Tawfek
3,998 reviews2,198 followers
February 2, 2023
Higher rating this time, because i like this kind of future planning, or even if its simply the writer making up his plot based on the chapters he already wrote, it doesn't matter it was great, i read the war twice, because i wanted to see it with a new eye after the revelation in the end.
A Big Dangerous Event happens this volume, actually its like 3 events or something, First An S Rank Gate shows up in the middle of Tokyo, typical Sung Jinwoo, not even considering going because he is busy with the second huge event that happens this volume..
Japan is lacking in manpower since they lost 7 S rank hunters in the Jeju Island Raid, where their target was to actually just let the Korean S rank hunters die.
Now they desperately need help, that they bought the help of a despicable S Rank national Russian hunter, he is treating them with complete contempt, just for the fact that he knows how powerful he is and how desperate they are for his help, by now it's obvious all the national level hunters are probably assholes, who care only about money and power.
Second Big Event, is sung going back to the double dungeon, where he finds The statue holding the commandments was the only real thing in the dungeon all along not the huge god, honestly for me this seemed like poking fun at Moses and the ten commandments, that it was always just Moses and the Big Great Scary god was fake.
Again i was right last review about another prediction, sung jinwoo had the power of the former monarch of shadows inside him all this time, the system was designed to make him stronger to prepare him to host the monarch who will take him over with the final gift the black heart, but sung controls it!
Gaining 100k mana, his legions are now immortal, and who knows if this makes him have more summons overall, like does that play factor like the intelligence stat?
Will he be able to reserve more shadows and summon more shadows at the same time?
specially after we saw what the monarch of shadows is capable of.
Third Big Event, is the Big War between the magic beasts, the silver warriors, the shadow host, and the Demon clans.
The battle starts between the magic beasts (who were not under the control of the monarch of shadow) and the silver warriors who pretty much look like freaking angels.
when the silver warriors were winning the battle, the monarch of shadows intervened, and raised the shadows of the dead magic beasts, and then the tide was turned, the silver warriors were now being wiped out.
Mid battle, the Demon armies enter the battle, and attack the shadow armies, along with the magic beasts, we learn that this was a betrayal of the monarch of shadows by the demons, the cause we do not know as its said in a demon language.
while the monarch of shadows did lose most of his troops, he won the battle, and killed the demon king baran, but that wasn't the end, the silver warriors are back, and now the monarch is alone, where he will probably die by their hands.
Now with what just happened sung jinwoo finally has the real power of the monarch of shadows, and he can probably now fight the monarch of ice and the other monarchs, hopefully one by one, because it would be ridiculous if he fought them all together and won.
Now for my theory on the system, which is most probably the truth.
I think the system programmed the entirety of the demon Castle, it was just a copy made by the architect to make sung jinwoo relive the triumphs of the monarch of shadows.
It also goes back to the test where he first got the monarch of shadows class, he literally killed dozens of steel soldiers that are the closest lookalikes to the silver warriors!
This volume also explains why the magic beasts never considered Sung Jinwoo as a human all along, because he never was just a human, a part of a monarch was inside him.
Baran was probably a monarch himself, a monarch of demons perhaps?
Along with the monarch of ice and the other monarch who we didn't learn his powers, we don't know much else.
The End, Sung Jinwoo, takes over the system, locking the architect out before killing him.
But not before the Architect gets away with one last prophecy!
When the pillars of fire supporting the skies are erected...
An unavoidable death will come and find you.

i needed to sit for a couple days before i wrote a proper review because i needed some time to fully take in this amazing series and that epic conclusion.

this is about to have some HUGEEEEEEEE spoilers!!

i did not expect it to end the way it did. at first i was feeling kind of mixed about it, because what do you mean he's using the cup of reincarnation and everyone will forget who he is and what he's done for the world??? it felt like MY world was crashing down because this man went through absolute hell plus haein would forget about him too!!! 😭😭💔💔 but quickly (like 5 seconds later) after feeling mixed about it, i was like, this is so true to his character and it wouldn't have made sense any other way. right from the beginning, he wanted to level up not for himself but so he could protect the ones he loves and the world. i think a lot of people feel he comes across as cold and morally grey but he's the complete opposite in my eyes. he's only ever wanted to help the world and that's why he chose to do it solo because he didn't want anyone else to get hurt because of him. he's just not the most social okay 😂 but he is the most selfless person out there. and with all the lives that were taken because of the war, of course if he had the chance to change that, he would. he didn’t even give it a second thought either too, he knew that’s what he wanted to do immediately 🥺 he doesn't only change it, he makes it so the world doesn't even need hunters in the first place. however that's because HE FIGHTS FOR 27 YEARS ALONE IN A DIFFERENT DIMENSION NON STOP SO THE MONARCHES COULDN'T ATTACK EARTH 😭 so he's already been through hell, fighting to get a cure for his mom, saving the literal world and DYING (plus way more), and now there's this!!

so anyway, i think the ending just fully proved more how amazing jinwoo is as an mc.

THE ENDING WITH JINWOO AND HAE MADE MY HEART IS SO COMPLETE 💕💖💗 yall do not understand how happy i was that the author gave us that at the end.

this is the most fun (and emotional) time i've had in a long time reading. it will forever be something i remember and constantly reread. this has become one of my favorite series of all time and i'm just so thankful i read it!! 😭

i will never move on...

side note: i need to mention jinwoo’s shadow monarch form BECAUSE HOLY SHIT THAT WAS FUCKING AWESOME 🔥 (i can't wait to see that animated can you imagine!!!! it's going to be sick af 🔥)

__

i can’t believe i am finished the main story. rtc when i gather my thoughts and stop crying 😭

Rod Brown

September 12, 2025
The big final boss battle in this penultimate volume is a bit of a murky mess with lots of bombast, posturing, sound effects lettering, cameos by unnamed secondary characters, and an ending that is true to the video game inspiration of this series -- -- but may be off-putting to some casual readers.

But this book has always been about an extremely overpowered protagonist, so I'll just roll with it like I did with Superman comics (and the second movie) when I was a kid.

I can't imagine what the final volume can possibly add to this one since it feels like a solid conclusion, but I'll certainly be back to check it out.

The fourth reread of the series is how I am stepping into the new year, doing what I love doing best, reading, and just to keep on reading. This is such a wonderful feeling to be able to enjoy the stories you love again and again. Last year, I did that with two series, this one and then The Path of Ascension series. I enjoyed both the experiences, and it was glorious. I hope to continue the journey going so let's go and Happy New Year to you guys.

Now the book is released, but the English version for Kindle still has to be released. But this was my third re-read of the series. Now onto the Side-stories.

This book is to be released on 28 Nov, but since it's a Webnovel, I read it earlier in March and re-read it now. The story ends at Chp. 179, and then there are 21 chapters covering the side stories and the further adventures of our hero. I would now be continuing to read and finish the series once again, and would read it again. So till next time let's Keep on Reading.

I have always loved comics, and I have I can. I love comics to bits, may the comics never leave my side. I loved reading this and love reading more. You should also read what you love and hope always to love them. Even though I grew up reading local Indian comics like Raj Comics, Diamond Comics, or even Manoj Comics, now's the time to catch up on international and classic comics and Graphic novels. I am on my quest to read as many comics as I just want to Keep on Reading.

Side Stories: ch180-ch192
my heart is aching, it's over. i feel like crying tears of happiness, that ending couldnt have been more perfect especially with the side stories🥹🥹 i truly have no words to add on about how much this series means to me i mean all my reviews of the previous arcs/volumes say it all too

the last manhwa to make me feel this way tower of god (which is still ongoing) but until that ends, solo leveling has definitely taken the place of being one of my favourite manhwas/mangas ever. sure, the plot isn't all that unique and is pretty basic but to have a basic plot and still manage to capture the hearts of readers in feeling so many different emotions and not get bored once??? that takes skill for sure and solo leveling so did that. and to add onto that the art is absolutely god tier--i am SO buying all the manhwa volumes once theyre all released

it hurts to know that ive completed this manhwa, even though i made myself slow down and stretch out the journey longer i knew it was only a matter of time and now that time has come. jin-woo is an amazing and compassionate warrior, friend, husband and father and truly i will be manifesting that there's a manhwa adaption with his son, suho🤞 beru has to be my favourite character of the series (sorry jin-woo, but you have to understand) and who would've thought that a giant ANT would be my favourite character bye-

but knowing that jin-woo was able to get his happiness and the love he deserves with all his friends and family gives me life, so many moments made me tear up. hae-in and jin-woo are perfect for each other and the fact that jinchul also has his memories of the previous timeline has me so happy 🥹 even though jinho doesnt, he and jin-woo still got to be best friends like brothers once again so nothing missed there <3

i was going to post all my favourite panels from the side stories but there's definitely no space for that in this review--so i'll leave that for when the last volume drops! edit: nvm im too lazy now to go searching & uploading because there's A LOT

ill keep at least one of beru though (actually made me emotional seeing beru so happy over suho's drawing of him😭🫶)

Finally finished this, but at what cost?

This all just goes back to my inability to DNF but I truly wanted to know how this would wrap up. I should’ve just listened to my gut feeling a few volumes ago; it didn’t get better.

In the end, I’d have a tough time saying if this was worth my time. Many of the final reveals feel lacklustre and fail to provide proper explanations. The characters remain surface level, and the story becomes a loop of fights with a predetermined winner.

This manhwa has an amazing set up and beautiful art style, but there’s not much else to it.

¡Me ha encantado! La serie tiene pequeñoa fallos y el protagonista está roto (lo señalo porque para mucha gente es un fallo, pero realmente hay una razón y es lo que mueve el conflicto final), pero esta historia y su mundo alternativo tienen muchísimo que aportar.

Muy recomendado si te gusta la fantasía y en especial la fantasía tipo juego mmo o de mazmorras.
